theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_regular_point_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ρ ∧ ball y ρ ⊆ U ∧ y ∈ M ∧ IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball y ρ → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) ∧ T.support ∩ ball y ρ = M ∩ ball y ρ
